notes.title: Trancelation exits Early Access, receives lots of updates!
notes.content:
Big news everyone! 

Trancelation exits Early Access stage with lots of new updates, performance and gameplay enhancements and most importantly: the revamped vocabulary lists system!

 Main updates: 

• 2 new arenas
• More settings (f.e. turn off dizziness)
• User Experience updates
• New tutorial/ onboarding mechanics
• Major changes to vocabulary lists system (completion indicators, notification support etc.)
• Gamepad support
• Lots of other gameplay & stability improvements

Stay tuned for more to come!
